concepts.reader_question: Dữ liệu qua rồi: ai xác nhận tiếp?
concepts.description: CARD-SPECIFIC TARGETED REGENERATION. Opening wider partner handoff scene: a neutral transmission path crosses between two blank physical work domains, then stops at an open receiving boundary. A distinct next-step surface remains unconnected, expressing that transmitted data has not established confirmation for further action. Use credible partner semiconductor architecture context and R2 photographic material depth with integrated physical relationship paths; maintain stable header typography, but vary perspective, scene scale and relation arrangement with card meaning. Every record, screen and prop is completely blank. No actual values, ERP/MES prop labels, letters/numbers/punctuation/microglyphs, dates, metrics, results, standalone question marks, ticks/checkmarks/seals, extra heading or completion icons. Print ONLY exact approved artwork fields/category/sequence and official mark once, without added headline punctuation. Frozen declared reference attributes only; never exact reference composition or undeclared direct-edit input.

P1-A1.headline: Dữ liệu qua rồi: ai xác nhận tiếp?
